mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, increasing serotonergic activity, while tamoxifen has weak serotonergic properties, creating potential serotonin syndrome risk; additionally, tamoxifen undergoes CYP3A4/2D6 metabolism which may be inhibited by phenelzine's effects on enzyme activity.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination is necessary, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and consider alternative antidepressant with lower serotonergic activity.
